annotations.note: app.include_router(web_routes.router) only when WEB_UI_ENABLED=true (evaluated at import).

Singletons are functools.lru_cache factories: get_settings, get_gateway_config, get_model_router, get_services, get_guardrails, get_rate_limiter, get_response_cache. lifespan() warms them and clears router/services on shutdown.
Tests replace get_db, get_model_router and get_services through app.dependency_overrides; routes see fake providers and an isolated config.
Web UI calls chat_completions/stream_chat_turn as plain functions with principal=None (default project).
conversations/memories routers are mounted only when STATEFUL_ENABLED=true; the web UI only when WEB_UI_ENABLED and STATEFUL_ENABLED (both read at import).
Providers are built by type in build_provider (gemini | openai_compatible | mock); deployments/groups come from gateway.toml via build_router. Routing edges are config-driven, not static calls.
